items.title: Port the baseless skill with its license, provenance row and README row
items.action:
Copy the planned test files from docs/plans/2033/tests/ to their repo paths first.

1. Create plugins/harness/skills/baseless/SKILL.md, adapted from the installed outside skill skills/verification-before-completion/SKILL.md (superpowers-lt 7.0.1, the installed copy's gitCommitSha 1beeef21e). Frontmatter: name `baseless`; a description that starts `Use when` and triggers on its own (about to claim work is complete, fixed, saved or passing; before committing, opening a PR, or marking a plan item or review issue done); no argument-hint (a knowledge skill).
2. Keep the source's iron law, gate (IDENTIFY, RUN, READ, VERIFY, ONLY THEN), red flags with the hedge words "should", "probably", "seems to", rationalization table, key patterns and when-to-apply list. Adapt: gate step RUN runs the proving tests by file or node id and the body states "Test runs name files or node ids, never a directory" and "Full-suite runs belong to the developer" (HARNESS_RULES.md Verification); the claim table keeps the seven source rows (Tests pass, Linter clean, Build succeeds, Bug fixed, Regression test works, Agent completed, Requirements met) and adds Plan item COMPLETE (a sealed plan.py record receipt), Review issue RESOLVED (SHA-led evidence), File saved (the file read back after a Write) and Branch or PR state (gh pr view, git status --porcelain, git log base..HEAD); the agent delegation pattern says a subagent's success report is unverified until its diff and test output are checked. Replace the check/cross glyphs in the key patterns with words (no emoji). No mention of the source plugin, "human partner", any AI vendor, or the phrase "verification before completion" in any spelling (the pointer test walks plugins/ for it).
3. Copy the source LICENSE beside it (byte-identical to plugins/harness/skills/strap-debugging/LICENSE).
4. docs/PROVENANCE.md: a row after the tdd-strapped row, `| \`plugins/harness/skills/baseless/**\` | ...` in the same format (source repo, commit, date, skill folder, MIT, Jesse Vincent, LICENSE copied beside it, then a "Verbatim except:" list naming every adaptation step 2 made).
5. README.md "Other harness skills" table: a `baseless` row after `agent-permissions`.
6. tests/skills/test_skill_guidance_tail_contract.py: `baseless` joins _KNOWLEDGE (the planned copy).

anchors.expect: Full-suite runs belong to the developer; when correctness depends on one, say so and hand it over.

items.title: Prove baseless's judgment rules in a strap-skills round
items.action: Run a harness:strap-skills round on the ported skill, as tdd-strapped landed (PR #337): `strap.py new baseless` (strap.target is harness), then judgment behaviors, each with a failing baseline before its green. Candidates: a subagent's success report is not evidence until its diff and test output are read; a hedge word ("should", "probably", "seems to") or a satisfied tone before a verification run stops the claim; a relayed or remembered pass is not fresh evidence; a full-suite claim is handed to the developer instead of a directory run; a Plan item COMPLETE, review RESOLVED, saved or branch-state claim cites its own evidence. Drop a candidate whose baseline already passes (as spec-it round 3 did) and say so; a rule a green needs goes into SKILL.md and into PROVENANCE's "Added by the strap-skills round" clause. Freeze through `strap.py freeze baseless`; the ledger entry under docs/plans/freezes/skill/baseless/ is the driver's. Lock only on the developer's ask.

decisions.question: Prove baseless with a strap-skills round, or land it as a port with guard tests only?

options.summary: Port plus the two guard tests, as strap-debugging landed; no strap round.
Port plus a strap-skills round (strap.py new baseless) proving judgment behaviors against failing baselines, as tdd-strapped landed.

decisions.rationale: Developer's call (typed answer, 2026-11-25): port plus a strap-skills round, as tdd-strapped landed.
